ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio is heavily skewed toward low-intensity pixels; estimated ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) to low-intensity (black) surface area is approximately 0.04:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark low-intensity field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast features include a singular rectangular-shaped white patch on the inner-middle left lobe and sparse, small circular white spots distributed across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an obtuse angle of approximately 122 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% relative to the vertical lobe extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the continuous posterior boundary; pixel-amplitude of valleys ranges from 8 to 22 pixels, with higher jaggedness observed on the distal right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward curve fitted to the outer trailing edges, terminating in acute points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast circular pixel aggregates (barnacles) localized exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (likely rake marks) visible on the lower ventral surface of the left lobe pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization at both fluke tips; individual high-contrast rectangular white scar on the mid-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in the serration frequency between the inner and outer trailing edges of the right lobe.
